LanguageData.SSC_Romance_AlreadyPartners: These pawns already have a romantic or marital relationship.
LanguageData.SSC_Romance_LoverRequired: A proposal requires a current lover relationship without an existing engagement or marriage.
LanguageData.SSC_Romance_NoRelationship: These pawns have no romantic or marital relationship to end.
LanguageData.SSC_Romance_RuleDenied: This pawn's romance permissions prohibit initiating this action.
LanguageData.SSC_Romance_OwnerOnly: This pawn may initiate romance or propose only to their bound master.
LanguageData.SSC_Romance_SexSection: Sexual behavior control (always accepts sex initiated by the master)
LanguageData.SSC_Romance_FirstStage: Stage 1 leaves this pawn’s romance behavior unchanged; the choices below are not active yet.
LanguageData.SSC_Romance_Independent: Romance rules are independent of the sexual behavior switch. Checkmarks show saved choices, retained while inactive or locked.
LanguageData.SSC_Romance_Setting_InitiateOnlyMaster: Initiate romance / proposals only with master
LanguageData.SSC_Romance_MasterPriority: Guaranteed acceptance for bound master {0} takes priority over response prohibitions; saved permissions apply to others.
LanguageData.SSC_Romance_PassiveMeaning: When off, remains a valid target but always rejects. When on, normal acceptance applies.
LanguageData.SSC_Romance_ExtraMeaning: These two rules are independent. Master-only does not re-enable prohibited initiation.
LanguageData.SSC_Romance_CommandOverride: This command overrides the executor’s initiation restrictions, master-only rule and autonomous willingness for this request. Saved choices remain intact.
LanguageData.SSC_Romance_BreakupPreview: Ends the current romantic / marital relationship without requiring acceptance. The chain binding remains.
LanguageData.SSC_Romance_Reception_Vanilla: The target follows their normal acceptance rules and may refuse.
LanguageData.SSC_Romance_Reception_ForceReject: The target’s current response permission forces rejection; the interaction can still occur.
LanguageData.SSC_Romance_Reception_ForceAccept: The executor is the target’s bound master and guaranteed acceptance is enabled. Acceptance is guaranteed once interaction requirements are met.
LanguageData.SSC_Romance_Scheduled: A targeted command from {0} to {1} is scheduled; interaction and response are pending.
LanguageData.SSC_Romance_InvalidPawn: This pawn is invalid or cannot act.
LanguageData.SSC_Romance_Identity: Requires an explicit SSC slave identity.
LanguageData.SSC_Romance_Stage: This setting is locked at the current chain stage.
LanguageData.SSC_Romance_Hollow: A hollow personality cannot use this control.
LanguageData.SSC_Romance_Loading: Save references are not fully restored yet.
LanguageData.SSC_Romance_UnsupportedConfig: Unknown romance configuration version; data is retained and this control is paused.
LanguageData.SSC_Romance_PlayerOnly: Only player-faction pawns can be edited or commanded.
LanguageData.SSC_Romance_StaleContext: The original interface context has expired. Reopen it.
LanguageData.SSC_Romance_InvalidAuthorization: The original command authorization is no longer valid.
LanguageData.SSC_Romance_CommandStage: Targeted commands require current chain stage 4.
LanguageData.SSC_Romance_HooksUnavailable: Required interaction adapters are unavailable; targeted commands are paused.
LanguageData.SSC_Romance_SameMapRequired: Both pawns must be alive and spawned on the same map.
LanguageData.SSC_Romance_UnableToInteract: The current pawn state prevents this social task.
